statement: Generic learners trained on up to 1e6 samples per curve (3 curves each of smooth, anomalous, prime order, 40 bits) found no leakage of k* bits or (+-k* mod q) mod 2: 216 fits, max z +1.50, none with |z|>3; on smooth curves they match the majority baseline (0.600/0.601/0.666) where Pohlig-Hellman gets 1.000.
